notes.title: BUG FIX
notes.notes:
FAITH & SHIELD has gone through an update that fixed bugs encountered during gameplay. 

Fixed bugs:
"Continue" option available when starting the game.
The law resolution of game have been fixed.
Audio effects have been fixed and adjusted.
The walking animation was fixed to enemies. 
The balance in the game was improved.
HealthBar added for enemy.
Damage indicator added.
And others...
